course_title: M.Sc. in Automotive Engineering and Mobility Systems

Elite English-taught Master of Science (120 ECTS) training researchers in quantum computing architectures (superconducting qubits, trapped ions), quantum cryptography (QKD), quantum optics, and open quantum systems simulation. Collaborative labs equip graduates for pioneering research in quantum hardware, quantum algorithms, and deep tech startups. Duration: 104 weeks. Tuition-free public university (0 EUR tuition; standard student semester administrative fee applies). Graduates are eligible for post-study work authorization and job seeker residence permits in Germany and the European Union.

World-renowned English-taught Master in International Management (120 ECTS) accredited by EQUIS, AACSB, and AMBA. Covers global corporate strategy, financial accounting, international marketing, managerial economics, digital transformation, and cross-cultural organizational leadership. Includes a mandatory 6-month corporate internship with top management consultancies and multinationals. Duration: 104 weeks. Standard non-EEA tuition is €22,500 per academic year. Graduates are eligible for post-study work authorization and job seeker residence permits in Ireland and the European Union.

course_title: M.Sc. in Quantum Science and Technology
syllabus_description: M.Sc. in Quantum Science and Technology (Masters) offered by National College of Ireland (NCI) in Dublin, Ireland. Language of instruction: 100% taught in English. Graduates are eligible for post-study work authorization and job seeker residence permits in Ireland and the European Union.

course_title: Master of Architecture (M.Arch) - Sustainable Urban Design

Professional English-taught Master of Architecture (120 ECTS) compliant with the EU Architects' Directive. Combines architectural design studios, circular building materials, parametric computational modeling (Rhino/Grasshopper), bioclimatic building physics, and historic preservation. Prepares licensed architects for leading European and international practices. Duration: 104 weeks. Standard non-EEA tuition is €2,800 per academic year. Graduates are eligible for post-study work authorization and job seeker residence permits in Italy and the European Union.

course_title: Master of Laws (LL.M.) in International and European Law
